verdict.rationale: Only a single thin mention of 'Azure Copilot' generating Terraform configurations shows any AI-generated suggestion capability; there's no evidence of broader in-product AI insights drawn from a user's actual data (e.g., cost anomalies, security posture, performance recommendations) and no independent corroboration. missing for 10: documentation of Azure Copilot/Advisor analyzing user data to produce insights, coverage across services (cost, security, monitoring), and independent/hands-on validation of these AI features.
